rfq_details.title: Cushman Utility Vehicles — Michigan Government Client
rfq_details.project_name: Cushman Utility Vehicles — Michigan Government Client

introduction: Dee Davis Inc. is requesting contractor/wholesale pricing for four (4) Cushman utility vehicles (or approved equal) for a Michigan government client. We are the prime contractor and you would be our supplier. Delivery to Southeast Michigan. Tax-exempt government purchase.

scope_of_work.title: SCOPE OF WORK
scope_of_work.description: Supply and deliver new Cushman Hauler 1200, Hauler Pro Elite, and Refresher Oasis utility vehicles per specifications below. All-inclusive pricing with delivery to Metro Detroit area. Net-30 payment terms preferred.
key_requirements: New equipment only (no used or refurbished)
Delivery to Southeast Michigan included in pricing
Service manuals and parts catalogs provided at delivery

items.description: Cushman Hauler 1200 Gas (or equal) — 2-seater, dark green, canopy, fold-down windshield, LED headlights, cargo box w/ electric bed lift, brush guard, 2" rear receiver, limited slip differential, USB port, 18x8.5-8 tires
items.specifications: Gas, 13+ hp, full spec per attached

items.description: Cushman Hauler Pro Elite Electric (or equal) — 2-seater, dark green, Elite 6.2 battery, rapid onboard charger, canopy, fold-down windshield, LED headlights, cargo box w/ electric bed lift, brush guard, 2" rear receiver, SOC meter, USB port, 18x8.5-8 tires
items.specifications: Electric, lithium battery, full spec per attached

items.description: Cushman Hauler Pro Elite Electric w/ Beverage Insert (or equal) — Same as 1b PLUS drop-in beverage insert w/ ice tray, premium seating, 20x8-10 tires, DC converter 30 amp

Cushman Hauler 1200 Gas w/ Beverage Insert (or equal) — 2-seater, white, 13.5+ hp, 1200 lb capacity, medium cargo box, 4-wheel hydraulic brakes, LED headlights, hinged windshield, heavy duty 2" rear receiver, drop-in beverage insert w/ ice tray, 20x8-10 tires

Cushman Refresher Oasis Gas (or equal) — 2-seater, white, 4 cold storage drawers, 12.1 sq ft wrap-around counter, merchandise cabinet, airpots, consumable ice bin, reversible bottle holder, 20.5x8-10 tires, halogen headlights, flat windshield w/ mirrors

submission_requirements.title: QUOTE SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS
items: PRICING: Provide complete unit pricing for each line item with any volume discounts
MANUFACTURER INFO: Include manufacturer name and part number for each item
DELIVERY: Specify lead time in business days and confirm FOB terms (destination preferred)
SHIPPING: State whether freight is included in pricing or quote separately
QUOTE FORMAT: Respond via email with itemized pricing in Excel/PDF format
PAYMENT TERMS: State your standard payment terms (Net 30, Net 60, etc.)
QUOTE VALIDITY: Confirm how long pricing remains valid
CONTACT INFO: Include primary contact name, phone, and email for follow-up questions

items.title: Payment Terms
items.description: Net 30 days from invoice date. Purchase orders will be issued upon award.

items.title: Delivery Requirements
items.description: FOB Destination preferred (freight included in price). Specify lead times for each item.

items.title: Contract Period
items.description: One-time purchase with delivery Spring 2026 with option to extend based on performance.

items.title: Product Quality
items.description: All products must be new, first-quality merchandise meeting manufacturer specifications.

items.title: Returns & Warranties
items.description: Defective items must be replaced within 5 business days at no charge.

items.title: Price Protection
items.description: Quoted prices remain firm for contract period unless mutually agreed in writing.
